title: Customer-Pay Repairs Estimating Bulletin: Quoted Part Type, Panel Blending and Customer-Supplied Parts
content:
For each Customer-Pay Repairs service tier, this bulletin fixes the part type a quote carries unless the customer chooses otherwise, whether blending into adjacent panels for color match is included in the quote, and whether parts the customer buys and brings are installed, with the handling charge that applies to them.

## By service tier

| Service tier | Part type quoted unless the customer chooses otherwise | Blending into adjacent panels included in the quote | Customer-supplied parts installed | Handling charge on their installation labor (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paintless Dent Repair Service | none | No | No | 0 |
| Cosmetic Touch-Up Service | none | No | No | 0 |
| Bumper Refinish Service | certified aftermarket | Yes | No | 0 |
| Panel Repair Service | certified aftermarket | Yes | Yes | 10 |
| Customer-Pay Collision Service | OEM | Yes | Yes | 10 |
| Complete Refinish Service | OEM | No | No | 0 |

## Definitions

- **Quoted part type**: Part type quoted unless the customer chooses otherwise: none, certified aftermarket or OEM.
- **Blending**: Whether blending into adjacent panels for color match is included in the quote (boolean).
- **Customer-supplied parts installed**: Whether parts the customer buys and brings are installed (boolean).
- **Handling charge**: Handling charge on the installation labor of customer-supplied parts (percent).

## Points of reading

- The quoted part type is the tier's standing choice; a customer may choose otherwise. Paintless Dent Repair Service and Cosmetic Touch-Up Service quote no parts (none); Bumper Refinish Service and Panel Repair Service quote certified aftermarket parts; Customer-Pay Collision Service and Complete Refinish Service quote OEM parts.
- Blending is included in the quote of Bumper Refinish Service, Panel Repair Service and Customer-Pay Collision Service only.
- Customer-supplied parts are installed only in Panel Repair Service and Customer-Pay Collision Service, each with a 10 percent handling charge on the installation labor of those parts. Hypothetical illustration: installation labor of 200.00 on a customer-supplied part carries a handling charge of 20.00 (10 percent of 200.00).
